```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
import markdown
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD CMS CONTENT
# ----------------------------------------------------------

with open("../../content/whalewatch_about.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

def md(value):
    return markdown.markdown(
        str(value or ""),
        extensions=["tables", "sane_lists"]
    )

def render_list(items):
    return "".join(
        f"<li>{safe(item)}</li>"
        for item in items
    )

hero = data.get("hero", {})
mission = data.get("mission", {})
species = data.get("species", {})
team = data.get("team", {})
funding = data.get("funding", {})
management = data.get("management", {})
additional = data.get("additional", {})
disclaimer = data.get("disclaimer", {})

traditional = management.get("traditional", {})
dynamic = management.get("dynamic", {})
importance = management.get("importance", {})

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# TEAM AND FUNDING
# ----------------------------------------------------------

team_list = render_list(team.get("organizations", []))

funding_list = ""

for item in funding.get("organizations", []):
    funding_list += f"""
    <li>
      <a href="{safe(item.get('url'))}"
         target="_blank"
         rel="noopener noreferrer">
        {safe(item.get('name'))}
      </a>
    </li>
    """

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# MANAGEMENT COMPARISON
# ----------------------------------------------------------

traditional_list = render_list(
    traditional.get("points", [])
)

dynamic_list = ""

for point in dynamic.get("points", []):
    dynamic_list += f"<li>{safe(point)}"

    if point == "Incorporates diverse data sources:":
        dynamic_list += f"""
        <ul class="cw-whale-about-nested-list">
          {render_list(dynamic.get('data_sources', []))}
        </ul>
        """

    dynamic_list += "</li>"

highlights_list = render_list(
    importance.get("highlights", [])
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
# ----------------------------------------------------------

additional_sections = ""

for section in additional.get("sections", []):

    items_html = ""

    for item in section.get("items", []):
        items_html += f"""
        <li>{md(item.get('text'))}</li>
        """

    additional_sections += f"""
    <details class="cw-whale-about-accordion">

      <summary>
        <span>{safe(section.get('title'))}</span>
        <span class="cw-whale-about-accordion-icon"
              aria-hidden="true">+</span>
      </summary>

      <div class="cw-whale-about-accordion-body">
        <ul>{items_html}</ul>
      </div>

    </details>
    """

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# PAGE HTML
# ----------------------------------------------------------

html = f"""
<div class="cw-whale cw-whale-about">

  <!-- PROJECT NAVIGATION -->
  <div class="cw-whale-topbar">

    <nav class="cw-whale-tabs"
         aria-label="WhaleWatch navigation">

      <a class="cw-whale-tab"
         href="whalewatch.html">
        WhaleWatch 2.0
      </a>

      <a class="cw-whale-tab is-active"
         href="about-whalewatch.html"
         aria-current="page">
        About WhaleWatch 2.0
      </a>

      <a class="cw-whale-tab"
         href="whalewatch-products.html">
        WhaleWatch 2.0 Products
      </a>

      <a class="cw-whale-tab"
         href="whalewatch-explorer.html">
        WhaleWatch 2.0 Explorer
      </a>

    </nav>

  </div>

  <!-- PAGE HERO -->
  <section class="cw-whale-about-hero">

    <span class="cw-whale-about-eyebrow">
      {safe(hero.get('eyebrow'))}
    </span>

    <h1>{safe(hero.get('title'))}</h1>

    <p>{safe(hero.get('subtitle'))}</p>

  </section>

  <!-- MISSION AND VISION — FULL WIDTH -->
  <section class="cw-whale-about-intro-grid">

    <article class="cw-whale-about-panel cw-whale-about-mission">

      <h2>{safe(mission.get('title'))}</h2>

      <div class="cw-whale-about-prose">
        {md(mission.get('description'))}
      </div>

    </article>

  </section>

  <!-- TARGETED SPECIES — FULL WIDTH HORIZONTAL CARD -->
  <section class="cw-whale-about-intro-grid">

    <article class="cw-whale-about-panel cw-whale-about-species">

      <h2>{safe(species.get('title'))}</h2>

      <figure>

        <img
          src="{safe(species.get('image'))}"
          alt="{safe(species.get('image_alt'))}"
          loading="lazy"
        >

        <figcaption>
          {md(species.get('caption'))}
        </figcaption>

      </figure>

    </article>

  </section>

  <!-- TEAM AND FUNDING -->
  <section class="cw-whale-about-info-grid">

    <article class="cw-whale-about-panel cw-whale-about-team">

      <h2>{safe(team.get('title'))}</h2>

      <p>{safe(team.get('description'))}</p>

      <ul>{team_list}</ul>

      <p>{safe(team.get('closing'))}</p>

    </article>

    <article class="cw-whale-about-panel cw-whale-about-funding">

      <h2>{safe(funding.get('title'))}</h2>

      <p>{safe(funding.get('description'))}</p>

      <ul>{funding_list}</ul>

    </article>

  </section>

  <!-- DYNAMIC OCEAN MANAGEMENT -->
  <section class="cw-whale-about-management">

    <div class="cw-whale-about-section-heading">

      <span class="cw-whale-about-section-label">
        OCEAN MANAGEMENT
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(management.get('title'))}</h2>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-whale-about-management-intro">
      {md(management.get('introduction'))}
    </div>

    <h3 class="cw-whale-about-comparison-title">
      {safe(management.get('comparison_title'))}
    </h3>

    <div class="cw-whale-about-comparison-grid">

      <article class="cw-whale-about-comparison-card cw-whale-about-traditional">

        <h4>{safe(traditional.get('title'))}</h4>

        <ul>{traditional_list}</ul>

      </article>

      <article class="cw-whale-about-comparison-card cw-whale-about-dynamic">

        <h4>{safe(dynamic.get('title'))}</h4>

        <ul>{dynamic_list}</ul>

      </article>

    </div>

    <!-- WHY IT MATTERS -->
    <div class="cw-whale-about-importance">

      <h3>{safe(importance.get('title'))}</h3>

      <div>
        {md(importance.get('description'))}
      </div>

      <h4>{safe(importance.get('highlights_title'))}</h4>

      <ul>{highlights_list}</ul>

    </div>

  </section>

  <!-- ADDITIONAL INFORMATION -->
  <section class="cw-whale-about-additional">

    <div class="cw-whale-about-section-heading">

      <span class="cw-whale-about-section-label">
        RESOURCES
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(additional.get('title'))}</h2>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-whale-about-accordion-list">
      {additional_sections}
    </div>

  </section>

  <!-- DISCLAIMER -->
  <section class="cw-whale-about-disclaimer">
    {md(disclaimer.get('text'))}
  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
